WITH cohort_admissions AS (
  -- women aged 86-96 inclusive and their hospital admissions
  SELECT
    a.hadm_id,
    a.subject_id,
    a.admittime,
    a.dischtime
  FROM
    `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` p
  JOIN
    `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` a
  USING (subject_id)
  WHERE
    LOWER(p.gender) = 'f'
    AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 86 AND 96
),

mcs_procedures_per_hadm AS (
  -- identify mechanical circulatory support (MCS) procedures and count distinct codes per admission
  SELECT
    pi.hadm_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pi.icd_code) AS num_mcs
  FROM
    `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.procedures_icd` pi
  JOIN
    `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.d_icd_procedures` d
  ON
    pi.icd_code = d.icd_code
    AND pi.icd_version = d.icd_version
  WHERE
    -- match common keywords for mechanical circulatory support procedures (case-insensitive)
    LOWER(d.long_title) IS NOT NULL
    AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(
      LOWER(d.long_title),
      r'ventricular assist|ventricular-assist|assist device|cardiac assist|mechanical circulatory|intra[- ]aortic|balloon pump|iabp|extracorporeal membrane|ecmo'
    )
  GROUP BY
    pi.hadm_id
),

per_admission_counts AS (
  -- include admissions with zero MCS procedures
  SELECT
    ca.hadm_id,
    COALESCE(m.num_mcs, 0) AS num_mcs
  FROM
    cohort_admissions ca
  LEFT JOIN
    mcs_procedures_per_hadm m
  USING (hadm_id)
)

SELECT
  quantiles[OFFSET(1)] AS q1_distinct_mcs_per_hadm,
  quantiles[OFFSET(3)] AS q3_distinct_mcs_per_hadm,
  (quantiles[OFFSET(3)] - quantiles[OFFSET(1)]) AS iqr_distinct_mcs_per_hadm
FROM (
  SELECT
    -- APPROX_QUANTILES(..., 4) returns an array of 5 values: [min, Q1, median, Q3, max]
    APPROX_QUANTILES(num_mcs, 4) AS quantiles
  FROM
    per_admission_counts
);
